companyBlurb: Result-driven workforce solutions — 25,000+ workers across 350+ cities in Indonesia.
summary: I build the field-worker app on both iOS and Android, covering attendance, payroll self-service, and digital field reporting. I started on Android in 2020 and added iOS in 2022.
highlights: Built the company design system from scratch for iOS (UIKit + SwiftUI, shipped as a Swift package) and Android (Jetpack Compose), with a playground app and CI-published releases.
Modularized the iOS app into Swift Package feature modules (auth, home, account, attendance, submission) on a Clean Architecture split of data, domain, and presentation.
Built a server-driven UI engine that renders native form widgets from a JSON Schema, with offline-first sync so field workers can submit reports without a connection.
Raised unit-test coverage across 6+ modules and replaced a code-generated mocking framework with lightweight manual mocks, guarded by coverage checks in CI.

Adopted AI-assisted development in late 2025. I wrote agent instruction files for 4 repositories and now work daily with Claude Code and OpenCode; in 2026 I merged about 1.4× more PRs per month while review and test gates stayed in place.
